title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to start and stop EC2 instances
description: Simple pattern that starts and stops given EC2 instances based on time of day, timezone and days of week

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Creates a schedule that turns on instances at 7:00am and turns them off at 18:00pm Monday to Friday using Europe/London timezone.
Example uses universal targets with EventBridge Scheduler to talk to the EC2 directly.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.

authors.name: David Boyne
authors.bio: Senior Developer Advocate at AWS focusing on EDA and Serverless.
